$meta.name: Isola Workspace design tokens
$meta.note: Dark is a value swap on identical token names. Components never branch on theme.

ok.rule: ONLY after the owning system has read the change back. Never for 'request accepted'.

warn.rule: Awaiting approval, due soon, stale data, configured-but-never-tested.

err.rule: Something did not happen and a customer may be affected. Always says whether the customer is affected.

info.rule: Running right now, outcome unknown. Pairs with a pulsing dot.

block.rule: Deliberately stopped: no permission, or a service is not answering. Distinct from failure.

neutralDashed.rule: Accepted by a downstream system but not confirmed. Rendered with border-style:dashed on surface-3.

panel.meaning: Chatwoot side panel only; Isola is the whole viewport

mobile.meaning: Same as panel, plus a back-to-conversation bar

laptop.meaning: Rail + thread + Isola panel; conversation list hidden

breakpoints.note: The design switches on available width for the workspace frame, not on device. Below 1090px the conversation list is dropped first; below 850px only the Isola panel remains.

motion.rise: iso-rise .2s–.25s ease — newly appeared results (readback, AI suggestion, toast)
motion.pulse: iso-pulse 1s–1.1s infinite — running indicator dot and progress bar
motion.rule: No decorative motion. Every animation communicates 'running' or 'this is new'. All must honour prefers-reduced-motion.

derivation.note: Given a single brand hex A, derive the rest so contrast holds in both themes.
derivation.accentHover: color-mix(in oklab, A, black 18%) — light; white 18% — dark
derivation.accentFg: color-mix(in oklab, A, black 22%) — light; white 32% — dark
derivation.accentSoft: color-mix(in oklab, A, white 90%) — light; #0D0D12 82% — dark

guardrails: Reject or auto-correct a brand accent that fails 4.5:1 against --iso-surface for accentFg.
A brand accent must never be applied to a status badge, alert, or checklist mark.
The accent carries no meaning by itself: it marks the active module, the single primary action, links and selection. Nothing else.

accessibility.contrastTarget: WCAG 2.1 AA — 4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large text and UI boundaries
accessibility.focus: 2px solid var(--iso-accent-ring), offset 2px, on every interactive element
accessibility.statusNeverColorAlone: Every status carries a text label; colour is redundant reinforcement
accessibility.liveRegions: role="status" on alerts, degraded/stale banners and toasts; aria-busy on loading containers
accessibility.tabs: role=tablist / role=tab / aria-selected on module navigation
accessibility.disclosure: aria-expanded on every expandable header button
